correctness.rationale: The parity shift is exactly a two-state essential graph and its radius-one predecessor presentation has five essential states. A complete subset-construction product with the even-shift word DFA exhausts 256 local rule codes, yielding exactly 16 endomorphism codes, equivalently eight distinct restrictions. Closed language-equivalence products prove the two proper image descriptions and exactly three onto shifts. Reachable deterministic integer adjacency matrices have verified characteristic polynomials t^3(t-1)(t+1)(t^3-t^2-1), t^3(t^3-t^2-1), and t^2(t-1)(t^5-t^4-t^3+t^2-1). Their Perron eigenvalues give the entropy spectrum. The bundled standard-library checker replays all computations and independent finite input/output comparisons through eight output symbols. No numerical extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The binary even shift is the basic strictly sofic example, so exact finite-observation endomorphisms constitute a motivated natural problem. The complete locality-one census gives a structural onto rigidity theorem, separates a proper mixing SFT image from a strictly sofic proper image, and determines the full exact entropy spectrum with two distinct nontrivial algebraic Perron roots. These are dynamical factor invariants not automatic from counting rule codes, and the output is a complete classification over all possible three-site binary local functions.
